Book a working session

Book · Thirty minutes

Bring your Monday question. We’ll work it in 30 minutes.

No deck. You bring one real question from your organisation; we show how the function would answer it, what data it needs, and what the first 90 days look like.

Who should come
The CHRO or the HR digitisation head, and whoever owns the HRMS. Three people at most.
What to bring
One question you have wanted answered for a while, and a rough headcount.
What you leave with
A written note within a day: the answer we would give, the data it needs, and a number for the engagement.
